settings.heading: Perfect Serve
settings.content:
Aperitivo Spritz

Ingredients

  • 150ml Prosecco
  • 50ml Aperitivo
  • 10ml sparkling water
  • Lime slice or zest for garnish
  • Ice

Recipe

  • Fill a tall wine glass with ice.
  • Add Prosecco.
  • Add Aperitivo.
  • Add sparkling water.
  • Stir gently.
  • Garnish with a lime wedge or zest.
  • Serve and enjoy.

You can find more recipes on our cocktail blog.

settings.heading: Ingredients & Allergens
settings.content:
Our Advent Calendar is not 100% vegan or allergen free as the Calendar includes one Moonshine variety that contains milk, one product contains nuts and one product is made from leather.

That makes 3 out of 24 doors which are not suitable for people with milk and/or nut allergies. For more information please feel free to email us on info@odonnellmoonshine.co.uk.

The Calendar is available only while stocks last.

1. How many different flavours of Moonshine does the Advent Calendar contain?

Our Advent Calendar contains ten different flavours.

2. When will the calendar be delivered?

Shipping will start in early October.

3. Is the content the same as in previous years?

No, the content of the Advent Calendar is new - but of course our best Moonshine flavours are back.
